alex: Heads up — observed a ~3-4x p95 decode increase on canary right after yesterday's merge (commit abcdef1). Repro steps and numbers below.

alex: p95 baseline (pre-merge): 85ms
alex: p95 canary (post-merge): 290ms
alex: commit: https://git.internal/redwood/serving/commit/abcdef1
alex: Repro (quick): `curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://canary.api.redwood/v1/decode`

maya: Is this only short-seq workloads? any diff between 1 vs 64 tokens?

alex: Short-seq heavy. 8-16 tokens show biggest delta. Long sequences ~unchanged.

cheng: Ran profiler on canary for shortseq load. High-level: kernel_selector spike -> choose_scalar_attn() and increased kv eviction heat. Top symbols from perf: `choose_scalar_attn` ~45%, `kv_evict_path` ~22%, `memcpy` ~10%.

luis: Metrics: kv.evictions/sec jumped from ~2 -> ~70 after merge. Batcher metrics show microbatch size collapse to 1 much more often (throughput drop).

alex: I can repro locally with `./run_perf.sh --model gpt-medium --batcher-mode canary --seq 16 --iter 200` — will upload full trace.

cheng: Did a bisect: heuristic tweak in commit bc1234d (PR #4321) changed the kernel-selection threshold for attention width and sequence length, causing selector to prefer scalar/fallback kernels for our short-seq distribution. Reverting that threshold returns p95 to ~90ms.

maya: Can we do a safety hotfix (override) while we decide? Is there a runtime knob to force kernel choice?

cheng: Yes. There is an override env var used for testing: `REDWOOD_KERNEL_HINT=matmul_fused` or `matmul_scalar`. Quick test: setting `REDWOOD_KERNEL_HINT=matmul_fused` on canary dropped p95 from 290ms -> 95ms.

alex: Opening a revert PR now (pr/7890) to rollback the heuristic tweak and add a gated flag for gradual reintroduce. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/pull/7890

luis: Also recommending we add an alert: kv.evictions/sec > 20 for >5m. We had no alert and missed early warning.

deploy-bot: canary deployment for pr/7890 started by @alex
deploy-bot: canary health checks: 5/5, p95 trending down (95ms -> 88ms)

maya: After revert canary looks stable. Please merge and promote with canary gating.

deploy-bot: rollout in progress: merging pr/7890 -> main
deploy-bot: rollout complete: pr/7890 merged and deployed to prod @ 2026-03-20T11:45Z :white_check_mark:

alex: Follow-ups assigned: cheng: add unit/regression tests around kernel thresholds + a perf-eval for short-seq microbench; luis: add kv_eviction alert & run a short alert drill; maya: add a short-seq perf-eval to CI gating. I'll write a brief postmortem.
